posts.name: Amnachaidh
posts.cooked:
On Friday, I had to pleasure of introducing SotM to about ten people.  I think everyone enjoyed the game, at least those who were vocal about it enjoyed the game quite a bit.

It turns out that two or three of the players there are heavily involved in U-Con, a local gaming convention.  I expect that >G may be contacted shortly to see if you wish to paricipate. If you are, fabulous! I look forward to meeting y'all.  If not, I'm happy to set up open games, and would look for any advice you might be able to give on doing so.

http://www.ucon-gaming.org/
